Bottom line rewritten from BEFORE's "이번 재확인은 전자는 참, 후자는 부분적으로 갱신되었다는 것을 보여준다" to AFTER's "분석의 스파인은 참으로 확인됐다. 그 스파인을 처음 뒷받침했던 개별 수치 하나만 사흘 사이 바뀌었을 뿐이다."; the table above it in-draft shows exactly one moved row and four confirmed, so the more assertive AFTER phrasing is supported by the draft's own evidence -- not an integrity change.

BEFORE heading "## 캐버트와 불확실성" used 캐버트, an ad-hoc transliteration of 'caveat' with no 외래어 표기법 form and not in 표준국어대사전; AFTER's heading "## 한계와 불확실성" eliminates the loanword entirely, resolving the norm-loanword-transliteration FAIL.

BEFORE's nominalisation "이 표의 관찰 가능성이 이 분석 전체의 핵심이다." is de-nominalised in AFTER to "이 표가 실제로 힘을 갖는 이유는 두 시나리오가 관찰로 바로 갈린다는 데 있다."; a second span replaces "~에 대한" with a native predicate ("신용위험을 다시 매긴 결과가 아니다"); ~적 count falls 4→2.

reg-report-bare-noun-compression fires once, correctly scoped to a forecast clause: BEFORE "다음 BOJ 회의와 JGB 입찰 결과가 이 질문에 더 직접적으로 답할 것이다." → AFTER "다음 BOJ 회의와 JGB 입찰 결과에서 더 분명한 답이 나올 전망.", one instance in a 10KB report.
Both drafts keep the practitioner English (term premium, credit crisis, OAS) consistently, pitched at the same practitioner-level report reader across BEFORE and AFTER.

BEFORE "원문의 가장 falsifiable한 주장" (an English adjective retained because it looked technical) → AFTER "원문에서 가장 반증 가능한 주장", standard Korean no analyst re-translates, while term premium / credit crisis / OAS are correctly kept per dom-practitioner-usage-retention.

No human has expressed a preference on this draft or any of the fifteen drafts read by the SUE-604 evaluation; editorial/voice.md records the voice, not a verdict on this text. Silence is not acceptance.

Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
